ValidationRule.description: IM-52: Restrict the status selection to any value except Ongoing and Complete if approved field is unchecked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Initiative_Validation__c && AND( RecordType.Name == 'Budgeted Initiative', Approved__c == FALSE, OR( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , 'Ongoing'), ISPICKVAL( Status__c , 'Completed') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can be set to Ongoing or Completed after Initiative Final Approval.
